title: Air Street newsletter: ASML cancels shipments of advanced lithography machines to China
summary: The newsletter reports that ASML announced at the start of January that it would cancel shipments of lithography machines to China.

title: Google DeepMind publishes AutoRT, SARA-RT and RT-Trajectory robotics work, including a 'robot constitution' safety rule set
summary: The safety rules for helper robots are inspired by Isaac Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics and are applied to the underlying language models.

title: AI Incident Database lists an unauthorised AI imitation of George Carlin used in a comedy special
summary: An AI-generated imitation of the late comedian was used in a comedy special without authorisation.

title: The Intercept: OpenAI removes 'military and warfare' from the list of uses its policy prohibits
summary: OpenAI's updated usage policy no longer lists military and warfare among prohibited uses, The Intercept reports.

title: OpenAI opens the GPT Store, a marketplace for custom GPTs
summary: The store was announced on 4 January and made available to the public on 10 January 2024, according to Spanish Wikipedia.

title: AI Incident Database lists Amazon product listings with ChatGPT error messages in their titles
summary: Many Amazon products were listed with titles containing ChatGPT error messages.

title: At Davos, Sam Altman says AGI could arrive in the 'reasonably close-ish future', Air Street newsletter reports
summary: AI was top of the agenda at the World Economic Forum meeting in January 2024; the AGI timing is Altman's own view.

title: Samsung and Google bring Gemini Nano and Gemini Pro to the Galaxy S24 range
summary: Google partnered with Samsung to integrate Gemini models into the Galaxy S24 phones, announced at Samsung's Unpacked event.

title: AI Incident Database lists a DPD customer-service chatbot that swore at customers and criticised its own company
summary: The chatbot malfunctioned, swore at customers and criticised its own company, according to the database.

title: AI Incident Database lists a robocall using a fake voice resembling President Biden that misled New Hampshire Democratic voters
summary: The call used a synthetic voice resembling Biden and targeted New Hampshire Democratic voters.

title: AI Incident Database lists a surge of deepfake nude images of Taylor Swift on social media
summary: A significant increase in deepfake nude images of the singer circulated on social media.

title: AI Incident Database lists a Nine Network AI-altered image of lawmaker Georgie Purcell
summary: Nine Network's AI reportedly altered an image of the lawmaker inappropriately.
